title: Welcome to My Blog

blocks.content:
This is my first blog post. I built this blog using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no backend required!

Everything you see here is loaded from a simple JSON file stored in my GitHub repository.
💡 Tip: You can edit the posts.json file directly on GitHub to add or update posts.

Quotes

title: How This Blog Works

blocks.content: Instead of using a traditional database like MySQL or MongoDB, this blog stores all posts in a JSON file inside a GitHub repository.
✅ All visitors see the same content because everyone is reading from the same JSON file.

Edit posts.json on GitHub
Commit the changes
The blog automatically fetches the latest version
Visitors see the updated content instantly
